scripts.compose:up: node scripts/run-docker-compose.js --env-file .env.docker.example -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --wait mongodb neo4j redis influxdb tsa witness backend worker frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix api/backend run test:ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix api/backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix api/backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix api/backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix api/backend run typecheck
